title: Define platform API client, retry, rate-limit, and rich-event normalization boundaries
description: TASK-023 covers transport/session/media lifecycle, but AstrBot's richer platform adapters also carry API clients, retry wrappers, rate-limit handling, WebSocket client errors, and platform-specific rich event normalization. Rust should keep those concerns separate from adapter transport and unified MessageEvent conversion.

files.change: Keep platform REST/WebSocket client details out of adapter event conversion.
Share retry/backoff semantics without coupling adapters to one transport implementation.
Normalize platform-specific media/reaction/thread fields before mapping into core message events.

criteria: Adapter transport, API clients, and event normalization are independently testable.
Platform-specific retry/rate-limit errors do not leak into core MessageEvent types.
Future Telegram/Lark/DingTalk/Misskey adapters can reuse common policies without sharing payload DTOs.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-platform && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
